class.name: ModifyAndroidBuildTemplatePlugin
class.brief_description: Editor plugin for installing FMOD Android libraries into the Android build template.
class.description: Adds [code]Configure FMOD Android Export[/code] to the editor Tools menu. Accepts an extracted FMOD Core Android SDK folder or a [code].tar.gz[/code]/[code].tgz[/code] archive and presents the proposed changes for review. Configures the installed Android build template: copies [code]fmod.jar[/code] and available ABI runtime libraries into debug, dev, and release directories; copies available arm64 extension libraries; updates Gradle dependencies and Java runtime initialization. This class is only available in the editor.
